location.en: Your studio, on the phone with Bayline Internet
location.zh: 你的套房，和 Bayline 網路公司通電話

goal.en: Set up internet at your new place and book a technician.
goal.zh: 幫新住處開通網路，並預約技術人員到府安裝。

background: small tidy studio apartment, wooden desk by the window with a closed laptop and a small router with blinking lights, a single bed with a gray blanket, soft afternoon light

intro.en: The last tenant left an old router in your studio, but the Wi-Fi cuts out every few minutes.
intro.zh: 前一位房客在套房裡留下一台舊路由器，但 Wi-Fi 每隔幾分鐘就斷一次。

intro.en: Time to get your own internet plan. You call Bayline Internet.
intro.zh: 該辦自己的網路了。你打電話給 Bayline 網路公司。

lines.en: Thank you for calling Bayline Internet. This is Jenna. How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 感謝您致電 Bayline 網路，我是珍娜。今天有什麼可以為您服務的嗎？

choices.en: Hi. I just moved, and I'd like to set up internet at my new place.
choices.zh: 嗨。我剛搬家，想在新住處開通網路。
choices.tip: I'd like to set up internet. 是開通網路的標準說法，先說明剛搬家，對方馬上知道要辦新裝。

choices.en: Hello. I want to apply the internet for my new apartment, please.
choices.zh: 你好。我想幫我的新公寓申請網路。

lines.en: Apply? Oh, are you applying for a job with us? Let me transfer you to our hiring team.
lines.zh: 應徵？喔，您是要應徵我們公司的工作嗎？我幫您轉接人資部門。

story.en: You listen to hold music for twenty minutes. Then a recruiter politely asks for your résumé.
story.zh: 你聽了二十分鐘的等候音樂。接著一位招募專員客氣地請你提供履歷。

fail.why: 「申請網路」不能直譯成 apply the internet。apply 常用在 apply for a job、apply for a visa。開通網路要說 set up internet 或 sign up for internet。

choices.en: Hi. I'm just moved to a new place. Can I get internet there, please?
choices.zh: 嗨。我剛搬到新家，可以在那裡裝網路嗎？

lines.en: Oh, you're moving soon? Then let's book it for after your move. How about next month?
lines.zh: 喔，您快要搬家了嗎？那我們等您搬完再安排，下個月可以嗎？

title.zh: 靠咖啡店 Wi-Fi 過活

story.en: Your setup gets booked for next month. You spend four weeks doing homework at the café down the street.
story.zh: 你的安裝被排到下個月。接下來四個禮拜，你都在街角的咖啡店寫作業。

fail.why: 「我剛搬家」是 I just moved 或 I've just moved。I'm just moved 不是正確句子，對方可能以為你「正要搬」。

lines.en: Welcome to the neighborhood! I can help with that.
lines.zh: 歡迎搬來這一區！這個我可以幫您處理。

lines.en: Is there already a router at your place?
lines.zh: 您那邊已經有路由器了嗎？

choices.en: Yes, the last tenant left one, but the connection keeps dropping.
choices.zh: 有，前一位房客留了一台，但網路一直斷線。
choices.tip: The connection keeps dropping. 精準描述「斷斷續續」，客服立刻知道問題在哪。

choices.en: Yes, there is one. But the internet is always broken, every few minutes.
choices.zh: 有一台。但網路每隔幾分鐘就壞掉。

lines.en: Broken? Is the cable damaged? Then we'll need to send a repair crew first.
lines.zh: 壞掉？是線路受損嗎？那我們得先派維修團隊過去。

story.en: A repair crew spends a whole morning checking every cable on your street. The cables are fine. Your setup waits another week.
story.zh: 維修團隊花了整個早上檢查整條街的線路。線路都沒問題，你的安裝又多等了一個禮拜。

fail.why: 「網路一直斷」不是 always broken，broken 聽起來像線路或機器壞掉。時好時壞要說 The connection keeps dropping.

choices.en: Yes, but it's garbage. Honestly, your company's internet is useless.
choices.zh: 有，但那台爛透了。說真的，你們公司的網路很沒用。

lines.en: I'm sorry you feel that way. That router isn't actually ours, but I'll make a note.
lines.zh: 很遺憾您這樣覺得。那台路由器其實不是我們的，不過我會記錄下來。

story.en: Jenna stays polite, but her voice gets noticeably cooler. You still don't know what's wrong with your Wi-Fi.
story.zh: 珍娜還是很有禮貌，但語氣明顯冷了下來。你還是不知道 Wi-Fi 到底哪裡有問題。

fail.why: 罵 garbage、useless 很失禮，接電話的客服也不是設備的負責人。描述問題就好：The connection keeps dropping.

lines.en: That old router is probably the problem. We can send a technician to install a new one.
lines.zh: 問題可能出在那台舊路由器。我們可以派技術人員幫您裝新的。

lines.en: When is a good time for you?

choices.en: Could you schedule a technician for Thursday? I'm free until noon.
choices.zh: 可以幫我預約星期四嗎？我中午以前都有空。
choices.tip: schedule a technician for + 時間，清楚說出日期和方便的時段，一次就能約好。

choices.en: Can the technician came on Thursday morning? I'm free until noon.
choices.zh: 技術人員可以星期四早上來嗎？我中午以前有空。

lines.en: Came? Oh, did a technician already visit you? Let me check our records.
lines.zh: 來過了？喔，已經有技術人員去過您那裡了嗎？我查一下紀錄。

story.en: Jenna spends ten minutes searching for a visit that never happened. By then, Thursday is fully booked.
story.zh: 珍娜花了十分鐘尋找一筆根本不存在的到府紀錄。等她查完，星期四已經約滿了。

fail.why: can 後面接原形動詞：Can the technician come...? 用了過去式 came，對方會以為技術人員已經來過。

choices.en: A good time? Oh, yes! I had a great time in Port Aurora last month.
choices.zh: 愉快的時光？喔，有！我上個月在極光港玩得很開心。

lines.en: That's... great! But I meant, when can the technician come to your place?
lines.zh: 那……很棒！不過我是問，技術人員什麼時候可以去您那裡？

story.en: Jenna politely listens to your whole trip story. By the time you finish, the only slot left is next Friday.
story.zh: 珍娜很有禮貌地聽完你整段旅遊故事。等你講完，只剩下禮拜五的時段了。

fail.why: When is a good time for you? 是在問你什麼時間方便，不是問你玩得開不開心。直接回答日期和時段就好。

lines.en: Done! A technician will be there Thursday between nine and twelve.
lines.zh: 好了！技術人員會在星期四九點到十二點之間過去。

lines.en: By the way, would you like to add our TV package? It's only fifteen dollars more a month.
lines.zh: 順帶一提，要不要加購我們的電視方案呢？每個月只要多付十五元。

choices.en: No, thank you. Just the internet for now, please.
choices.zh: 不用了，謝謝。目前只要網路就好。
choices.tip: No, thank you. Just ... for now. 拒絕推銷清楚又客氣，for now 還保留了以後的空間。

choices.en: No. Stop trying to sell me things. I just want internet.
choices.zh: 不要。別一直推銷東西給我。我只要網路。

story.en: Jenna wraps up the call in record time. Only after you hang up do you realize you never asked how much your plan costs.
story.zh: 珍娜用最快的速度結束通話。掛掉電話後你才想到，自己根本沒問方案多少錢。

fail.why: 介紹加購方案是客服的例行工作，直接叫對方別推銷太衝。禮貌拒絕就好：No, thank you. Just the internet for now.

choices.en: Hmm, maybe. Let me think about it and get back to you.
choices.zh: 嗯，也許吧。我考慮看看再跟你說。

lines.en: Oh, sure! So should I call you tomorrow evening to follow up?
lines.zh: 喔，好的！那我明天晚上打給您確認，可以嗎？

story.en: You say "sure" just to be polite. Jenna calls every evening for a week to ask if you've decided yet.
story.zh: 你出於禮貌說了「好」。結果接下來一個禮拜，珍娜每天晚上都打來問你決定了沒。

fail.why: 台灣人說「我考慮看看」常是委婉拒絕，但英語客服會當真，還會持續追蹤。不需要就直接說 No, thank you.

lines.en: Perfect. You're all set! Have a great day.
lines.zh: 太好了，都安排好了！祝您有美好的一天。

lines.en: On Thursday, the technician installs a new router in twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 星期四，技術人員只花二十分鐘就裝好新的路由器。

story.en: Full bars, no drops. That night, you video call your family in Taiwan without a single freeze.
story.zh: 訊號滿格，完全不斷線。那天晚上，你和台灣的家人視訊，畫面一次都沒卡住。

notes.explain: set up 用在開通網路、建立帳戶、安裝設備。I'd like to 比 I want to 客氣，打電話給客服很好用。

example.en: I'd like to set up a new phone plan.
example.zh: 我想要辦一個新的手機方案。

notes.explain: keep + V-ing 表示某件事一直重複發生。drop 在這裡是「斷線」，也可以說 The Wi-Fi keeps cutting out.

example.en: My calls keep dropping in the basement.
example.zh: 我在地下室講電話一直斷線。

notes.explain: schedule 當動詞是「安排時間」。到府安裝或維修的人通常叫 technician，不叫 worker。

example.en: Can we schedule a technician for Monday afternoon?
example.zh: 我們可以預約星期一下午的技術人員嗎？

notes.en: When is a good time for you?
notes.explain: 這句是在問方便的時間，不是問你玩得開不開心。have a good time 才是「玩得愉快」。

example.en: When is a good time to call you back?
example.zh: 什麼時候方便回電給你？

notes.explain: 在台灣常是委婉拒絕，但英語客服和業務會當真，之後還會再來追蹤。不需要就直接說 No, thank you.，一點也不失禮。

example.en: No, thank you. I'm happy with my plan.
example.zh: 不用了，謝謝。我目前的方案就很好。
